title: What's the difference between daily and monthly limits?
summary: This document compares daily vs monthly sending limits: daily applies per day ($750 new accounts, $3,500 verified) and monthly applies per month ($7,500 new, $35,000 verified). Both limits are enforced simultaneously; payments can be declined if they exceed remaining daily or remaining monthly capacity.
